WorkQueue.asked.hint: Asked for by your action in the interface: it goes ahead of the background's computations, never stopping the one running
WorkQueue.hint: Every computation runs one at a time, whole, in the order asked. A planned one waits for the changes to settle, and newer changes put it off. How long one takes is told by the last run of the same work since the application started.
WorkQueue.loadError: The queue could not be read: {{error}}
WorkQueue.state.FAILED.hint: Ended with an error: see the application's log
WorkQueue.state.FINISHED.hint: One of the last five done
WorkQueue.state.GIVEN_UP.hint: New data came while it ran: given up, done again on them — no error
WorkQueue.state.WAITING.hint: Waits its turn: first those your actions asked for, then the rest — each in the order asked
